messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Integer-grid lattice search with post-hoc continuous relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration for maximizing the minimum triangle area in the unit square can be found by first restricting to a 21x21 integer lattice and enumerating all C(441,13) subsets via branch-and-bound with area pruning, then applying continuous relaxation via sequential quadratic programming starting from the best lattice solution. The conjectured optimal minimum triangle area is 1/42 ≈ 0.02381, achievable by a configuration derived from a 6x6 base lattice with points at positions encoding a balanced incomplete block design, subsequently relaxed to break lattice symmetry. This lattice-first approach is conjectured to outperform direct continuous optimization because the integer grid provides a dense enough sample of the feasible region to capture the global optimum's combinatorial structure while the relaxation recovers any sub-lattice-spacing perturbations needed for optimality."}
